sb.name: Angel
sb.damage_resistances: radiant; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The angel's weapon attacks are magical. When the angel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d10 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The angel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Evil And Good|detect evil and good]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Commune|commune]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|raise dead]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The angel makes four melee attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.desc: The angel touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 (4d8 + 2) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The angel magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the angel's choice). In a new form, the angel retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

sb.name: Construct (Animated Armor)
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The construct is incapacitated while in the area of an [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|antimagic field]]. If targeted by [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], the construct must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the construct remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of construct.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The construct makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Construct (Helmed Horror)
sb.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 14
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The construct has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spell Immunity
traits.desc: The construct is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical immunities include [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|fireball]], [[Tools/Spells/Heat Metal|heat metal]], and [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]].

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The construct makes two longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.desc: The construct can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.desc: If the construct dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind its weapons and anything else it was carrying.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

sb.name: Construct (Shield Guardian)
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10
sb.languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

traits.name: Bound
traits.desc: The construct is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the construct and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the construct to travel to it, and the construct knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the construct is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the construct.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The construct regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.desc: A spellcaster who wears the construct's amulet can cause the construct to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the construct. The spell has no effect but is stored within the construct. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the construct casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The construct makes two fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.desc: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the construct's amulet, the construct grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the construct is within 5 feet of the wearer.

sb.name: Demon
sb.damage_resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Hellish Weapons
traits.desc: The demon's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 (3d8) necrotic damage on a hit (included in the attacks).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The demon makes three attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The demon adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the demon must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Dragon
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Fiery Bite (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 63 (18d6) fire damage. This counts as a use of the dragon's breath weapon.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: The drake has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drake makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The drake doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.desc: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

traits.name: Aether Scent
traits.desc: The gremlin can pinpoint, by scent, the location of refined or unrefined aether within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Siphon
actions.desc: The gremlin drains aether from an aether-powered device it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch automatically drains aether. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to keep it out of the gremlin's reach. If the aether-powered device grants any bonus (to attack rolls, damage rolls, Armor Class, and so on), that bonus is reduced by 1. If the device has charges, it loses 1 charge. Otherwise, it stops functioning for 1 round. Left unhindered, a gremlin can completely destroy an aether-powered device.

sb.name: Hellion (Huge)
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.desc: A creature that touches the hellion or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the hellion can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The hellion makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hellion, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the hellion's turns. If the hellion takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the hellion must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the hellion. If the hellion dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

sb.name: Hellion (Large)
sb.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.desc: A creature that touches the hellion or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If the elephant moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the leviathan. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the leviathan, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the leviathan's turns. If the leviathan takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the leviathan must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the leviathan. If the leviathan dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The whale makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Flipper
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the whale. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the whale. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.desc: The thopter can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the thopter's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The thopter doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

sb.name: Thopter (Pseudodragon)
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13
sb.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.desc: The thopter can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 feet of it that can understand a language.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target falls unconscious for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The thopter can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The thopter has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the thopter's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

sb.name: Wurm
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 9

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wurm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the wurm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the wurm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. If the wurm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wurm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wurm. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
